item.title: StoryShape 0.1.22
item.description:
# StoryShape 0.1.22 beta (build 23)
StoryShape is a free Mac beta for writers building books, plots, and connected worlds. It works locally without an account or an internet connection for ordinary writing.
This update focuses on the everyday flow of organizing a manuscript:
- Books and chapters open as scene cards by default. You can rearrange cards and use the library's contextual actions to add or rename manuscript items. - Plan makes it easier to switch plots, choose a template, create a named beat, connect beats, and move around the canvas. - World opens to a Wiki home with topics, recent entries, and author-featured starting pages. Entry pages put relationships and backlinks beside the lore, with a path back to the home page. - The bundled Wonderland tour features key World pages to demonstrate the new Wiki navigation.
The DMG is for Apple-silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. The ZIP is for StoryShape's manual **Check for Updates** command; there are no automatic update checks. Existing local projects remain yours. As this is a beta, keep an independent backup of important work.
StoryShape's current first-party source is maintained privately by Iron Candle Interactive. Earlier publicly released Apache-licensed source retains its historical license. Bug reports and feature requests are welcome at [StoryShape Feedback](https://github.com/IronCandleInteractive/StoryShape-Feedback).

item.title: StoryShape 0.1.21
item.description:
# StoryShape 0.1.21 beta (build 22)
StoryShape is a free, local-first writing studio for Apple-silicon Macs. The Mac source is open under Apache 2.0; the separate iPad application remains in development and closed source.
This release retains the expanded, editable Wonderland Chapter I tour: five scenes, linked plot beats, freely arranged Board notes, a connected World Wiki, revision examples, and a five-stop journey map. The chapter text is Lewis Carroll's public-domain work in the United States; planning and World notes are illustrative additions.
Write offers two editable scenes side by side, page and pageless views, margins and zoom, a centered focus view, and StoryShape Premium. Revise supports scene markup and numbered passes. World supports named links, an automatic or manually arranged connections graph, and a map you can consult while writing or planning.
Build 22 is a freshly signed and notarized Mac download aligned with the Mac App Store packaging and review build. The DMG is for drag-to-Applications installation; the ZIP supplies the same signed app for the **manual** Check for Updates command. StoryShape does not check for updates automatically or upload project data.
**Beta caution:** Keep independent backups of important work. Native macOS 14 GUI testing, physical 16 GB hardware testing, broader accessibility checks, and an independent writer pilot remain open. The Mac App Store and iPadOS editions are still in development.
## Verify the downloads
Checksums and exact byte sizes will be added after the DMG's separate Apple notarization and stapling complete.
Report bugs or feature requests in [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/IronCandleInteractive/StoryShape/issues) or email support@ironcandleinteractive.com.

item.title: StoryShape 0.1.20
item.description:
StoryShape 0.1.20 beta for Apple-silicon Macs
This build expands the editable Wonderland tour into five Chapter I scenes with a connected plot, movable Board notes, source-linked Wiki entries, revision examples and a five-stop journey map. Carroll's original chapter is retained with the project; the planning and World material is illustrative.
Write now supports two editable scenes side by side, page and pageless views with zoom and margins, a refined focus mode, and StoryShape Premium's warm interface with a white writing page. Revise includes scene-specific markup and numbered revision passes. World adds named connections with automatic and saved arrangements, along with a map you can open while writing or planning.
This remains a beta. Keep independent backups of important writing. Native macOS 14 GUI, 16 GB hardware, broader input/accessibility and independent writer-pilot qualification remain open. The Mac App Store and iPad editions are still in development. Check for Updates runs only when you request it; StoryShape does not check at startup.
The bundled dependency notice now names Sparkle and points to its included license.
